meta.title: Commercial-Success & Engagement Factors
meta.purpose: Researched predictors of audience engagement, box-office, and streaming retention — the basis of the Hit-Potential scoring module.
meta.caveat: Predictors are correlational and context-dependent; use as guidance/scoring, not guarantee.

research_findings.finding: Screenplay text-network size (main component) predicts opening-weekend box office with high significance (p < 0.0001).
research_findings.implication: Structural richness/connectedness of the story matters, measurable pre-production.
research_findings.source: Predicting Box Office from the Screenplay (empirical model)

research_findings.finding: AI screenplay analysis achieved ~87% financial accuracy on historical greenlight decisions, outperforming a studio's own process by ~5x.
research_findings.implication: Pre-production idea validation is viable and valuable.

research_findings.finding: NLP + ML at pre-production improved profitability prediction by ~11.9% (F1 ~75.1%).
research_findings.implication: Text/story features carry real signal before a frame is shot.

research_findings.finding: Netflix judges titles by completion rate, viewing velocity, and rewatch behavior — retention, not just starts.
research_findings.implication: Optimize for finishing and re-watching, not just the hook.

research_findings.finding: ~65% of Netflix movies run 90-120 min; that band boosts completion by ~20%.
research_findings.implication: Runtime discipline improves completion; keep it tight.

research_findings.finding: Movies now outperform TV on Netflix on completion, lower viewership decline, and minutes streamed.
Global, culturally-specific storytelling (e.g., Squid Game, Lupin) drives loyalty and differentiation.
research_findings.implication: Specific + universal beats generic; local texture travels.

hit_potential_scoring.note: Dimensions the validation module scores each candidate concept on (0-1). Weighted sum = hit-potential.

dimensions.measures: clear, relatable feeling the audience latches onto
fresh angle on a recognizable promise (novel but legible)
delivers or knowingly subverts genre expectations
